title: Leftovers, Week 6
dek: Kendre Miller took the Saints' backfield while Alvin Kamara's back acted up, and Cam Skattebo played six snaps for the Giants.
author: Chef Hazy
intro_md:
Updated Mon 4:30 PM ET: Cam Skattebo is a hold until the Week 7 depth chart and practice reports say who leads the Giants' backfield. A.J. Brown had 3 drops on 10 targets; still a hold. Romeo Doubs has no diagnosis and Mike Vrabel would not commit to him for Thursday; monitor Tuesday's report. Ashton Jeanty stays a hold, with Mike Washington Jr. taking half the early downs.

What's still good from Week 6, PPR scoring, every game from Thursday night through Sunday night. Washington at San Francisco plays Monday night and goes into Tuesday's Market Run, and CIN, DET, MIA and MIN were off. New Orleans handed its backfield to Kendre Miller, the Giants took Cam Skattebo off the field and changed quarterbacks mid-game, Rico Dowdle came back in Pittsburgh, and Caleb Williams returned in Atlanta. Ranks are rest of season for me; the Week 7 Menu comes Wednesday.
outro_md: The misses, owned. Bijan Robinson was RB1 for me; he touched the ball 11 times while Chicago kept it for 40 minutes. Cam Skattebo was RB17; he played 6 snaps. Emanuel Wilson was RB16 Thursday; George Holani out-snapped him 49 to 27 and Wilson ran 14 times for 52. Pat Freiermuth was TE12; he caught 2 for 11 while Darnell Washington scored. Juwan Johnson was the TE8 pivot for Tyler Warren; he was shut out on 2 targets. The lesson: a fill-in back's snap share matters more than the carries the week before, and a tight end living on touchdowns with no target volume is a coin flip, not a TE1. The Menu weighs both from Wednesday on.

takeaways.headline: Kendre Miller took the Saints' backfield
takeaways.text: Kendre Miller (NO) ran 20 times for 70 in the 34-27 win @NYG and played 32 snaps, the most of any Saints back. Alvin Kamara (NO) left in the second quarter with the back, came back, scored on a 31-yard catch, then sat the whole fourth quarter; he finished with 19 snaps and 7 carries for 34. CJ Donaldson played 24 snaps on third downs. Claim Miller, 5 to 10 percent of FAAB. Kamara is RB45 rest of season for me; monitor Wednesday's injury report on the back.

actions.watch: Wednesday's Week 7 injury report on the back

takeaways.headline: Cam Skattebo played six snaps
takeaways.text: Cam Skattebo (NYG) played 6 snaps and had no carries vs NO, a week after his fourth lost fumble of the season. John Harbaugh said he did not bench him and called it not by design. Najee Harris started, Tyrone Tracy Jr. (NYG) scored twice on 8 touches, and the Giants' backs ran 14 times for 34 between them. Jameis Winston was benched after his second interception, and J.J. McCarthy threw for 243 in the last 11 minutes; Harbaugh has not named a starter. Harbaugh said someone needs to step up and be the back, so the Week 7 depth chart and practice reports decide it; hold Skattebo for now. Tracy is a deep-league add, 0 to 2 percent of FAAB.

actions.why: He played 56 snaps the week before; the Week 7 depth chart and practice reports decide it, and a second straight game under 15 snaps @HOU makes him a sell.

takeaways.headline: Rico Dowdle is back, and Jaylen Warren still closed
takeaways.text: Rico Dowdle (PIT) was active for the first time since Week 2 and ran 7 times for 40 with 3 catches @TB. The split started close to even, then Jaylen Warren (PIT) took over in the fourth quarter and overtime with 4 carries and a catch on the winning drive. Warren finished with 14 carries for 50 and 2 catches for 28. Warren is RB23 rest of season for me; hold him. Dowdle is RB34 rest of season for me; monitor his snap share vs NO in Week 7.

actions.why: He closed the game; Dowdle matching his snaps for a second week is what would reopen the sell.

actions.watch: his snap share vs NO in Week 7

takeaways.headline: Bam Knight out-ran Tyler Allgeier
takeaways.text: With Jeremiyah Love out, Tyler Allgeier (ARI) played 40 snaps to 32 for Bam Knight (ARI) in the 18-16 win @LAR. Allgeier ran 18 times for 38. Knight ran 15 times for 80, caught 2 for 18 and got most of the red-zone touches, though Arizona went 0 for 5 there and Chad Ryland kicked six field goals. Knight had his wrist looked at and came back the next drive. Add Knight, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB. Drop Allgeier for any add on the list. Love is RB15 rest of season for me; monitor Wednesday's practice report.

takeaways.headline: Pierre Strong led Green Bay, and Josh Jacobs is next
takeaways.text: Pierre Strong Jr. (GB) played 41 snaps to MarShawn Lloyd's 30 in the 23-13 win over DAL, ran 11 times for 28 and caught 5 of 6 for 39. Lloyd (GB) ran 8 times for 10. Josh Jacobs (GB) is expected off the commissioner's exempt list Monday and is eligible for Week 7. Drop Lloyd for any add on the list. Jacobs is RB37 rest of season for me; monitor his activation and Wednesday's practice report. Monitor Strong's snap share once Jacobs is active.

actions.watch: his activation this week and Wednesday's practice report
his snap share vs CAR once Jacobs is active

takeaways.headline: A.J. Brown got the targets, not the catches
takeaways.text: A.J. Brown (NE) drew 10 targets in his first game off IR in the 26-19 win over NYJ and caught 3 for 27, with 3 drops, the most he has had in a game. Romeo Doubs (NE) caught a 42-yard TD and hurt his shoulder on the dive; Mike Vrabel would not commit to him for Thursday @CHI and the team has given no diagnosis. DeMario Douglas (NE) caught 7 of 8 for 86 and a TD. Brown is WR24 rest of season for me; hold him. Doubs is WR46 rest of season for me; monitor Tuesday's injury report. Add Douglas for Thursday in PPR, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB.

actions.why: Ten targets in his first game back is the role; a second game under 6 targets is what would move him down.

takeaways.headline: Caleb Williams came back sharp
takeaways.text: Caleb Williams (CHI) went 30 of 36 for 305 and a TD in the 31-23 win @ATL, his first game since Week 2, and completed his first 12 throws. Luther Burden III (CHI) caught all 8 of his targets for 95. Colston Loveland caught 6 of 7 for 65 and a TD. D'Andre Swift scored twice, but Roschon Johnson took 13 carries to Swift's 16. Williams is QB10 rest of season for me; trade for him in superflex, offer a WR3. Burden is WR28 rest of season for me; trade for him, offer a WR4 and a bench RB.

actions.price: a WR4 and a bench RB

usage.why: Montgomery is week to week; his return to practice is what would cut Marks' work. RB40 rest of season for me.

usage.why: A second game with Rodriguez near even on the carries is what would move him down. RB18 rest of season for me.

usage.read: Every Philadelphia rushing yard in the 25-14 loss to CAR, with Saquon Barkley out a second week and Tanner McKee at quarterback.
usage.why: He is the only healthy back with Carson Steele's shoulder hurt; Barkley practicing in full is what ends it.

usage.read: Kenny Gainwell had 2 carries with Sean Tucker out; Tampa Bay ran into loaded boxes with Jalon Daniels at quarterback.
usage.why: The volume is his; Baker Mayfield's return opens the field back up. RB17 rest of season for me.

usage.read: His first NFL touchdown in the 26-20 win @IND, tied for Tennessee's target lead a week after 1 for 6 on 5 targets through a back injury.
usage.why: Seven targets on Cam Ward's 22 throws is a top role; a third straight game under 4 catches would change it. WR32 rest of season for me.

usage.read: He led the backs in snaps, but Corey Kiner ran 11 times for 57 and TreVeyon Henderson came back with 7 carries for 31.
usage.why: He led the backs with 41 snaps; Henderson passing 30 percent of the snaps is what would move him down. RB24 rest of season for me.

usage.read: Active off IR in the 13-10 loss @CLE, and Rashod Bateman left with the shoulder in the second quarter, though Baltimore's coach said Monday Bateman should be OK. Lamar Jackson is day to day for Week 7.

Both fourth-quarter scores in the 33-30 loss to BUF, including a 44-yarder. Michael Mayer caught 7 for 95 and Brock Bowers had no first-half targets.

usage.why: He played 58 percent of the snaps and out-touched Washington 14 to 10, but Washington took half the early-down snaps. Hold; watch the early-down split vs KC in Week 7. RB8 rest of season for me.

usage.why: He still out-touched Corum; Corum leading the carries is what would move him down. RB12 rest of season for me.

overreactions.take: Germie Bernard is Pittsburgh's No. 2 receiver for real
overreactions.why: 12 targets, 11 catches for 87 and the overtime TD @TB, a week after 9 targets vs IND. DK Metcalf drew 15, and the next receiver drew 6. Pittsburgh's receiver room is thin for weeks. Claim him, 5 to 10 percent of FAAB.

overreactions.take: Chuba Hubbard is a workhorse again
overreactions.why: 28 carries for 120 and a TD @PHI, including a 19-yard run on fourth-and-1, and no other Carolina back had more than 1 carry. RB25 rest of season for me, and the touches say higher. Trade for him; offer a WR3.

9 carries for 61 was the game script. Chicago held the ball for 40 minutes and ran 73 plays to Atlanta's 50, and Brian Robinson Jr. had 2 carries. He was not hurt. RB2 rest of season for me; hold him. Chicago's clock control did it; a second game under 12 touches in a normal script is what would change it.

overreactions.take: Jonathan Taylor is losing work to Seth McGowan
overreactions.why: 21 carries for 94 and a TD plus 57 receiving yards vs TEN, a season-high 151 from scrimmage. McGowan ran 4 times for 27. RB3 rest of season for me; hold him. McGowan taking the goal-line carries is what would change it.

7 carries for 18 @KC behind a line missing Joe Alt, but he led the Chargers' backs in routes and targets with 4 catches. Kimani Vidal ran 7 times for 21. LAC is off in Week 7. RB14 rest of season for me; hold him through the bye. Vidal leading the backs in snaps after the bye is what would change it.
